title: Move LocationFetchResult out of data/services/location_service.dart so presentation stops importing data/ directly
why: sacred_time_settings_card.dart is a presentation/widgets file; it imports data/services/location_service.dart purely to pattern-match on LocationFetchResult/LocationFetchSuccess/etc. in _showOutcome(). Every other cross-layer type this feature exposes to presentation (City, SacredLocation, SacredWindow) correctly lives in domain/models/ — LocationFetchResult is the one outcome type stranded in data/, forcing presentation to reach past domain into data, breaking the layering the rest of the feature follows consistently.
recommendation: Move the LocationFetchResult sealed hierarchy to domain/models/ (LocationService in data/ still constructs and returns it); presentation then only ever imports domain/ or providers/ from this feature, never data/.
acceptance_criteria: LocationFetchResult and its variants live under domain/
No file under sacred_time's presentation/{screens,widgets}/ imports anything from data/
flutter analyze / make audit stay clean after the move
